articles.summary: Net sales of $1,698.3 million; increase of 4.6%; organic increase of 5.2% Diluted GAAP EPS of $0.30; adjusted EPS of $0.22 Raised FY 2026 organic revenue growth, adjusted EPS and free cash flow guidance Avantor, Inc. (NYSE: AVTR), a leading global provider of mission-critical products and services to customers in the life sciences and advanced technology industries, reports results that exceeded management's expectations for revenue and adjusted EPS for the third fiscal quarter of 2026. Emmanuel Ligner, President and Chief Executive Officer, says: "We are delighted to return to year-over-year growth in the third quarter. We are not done with our Revival journey yet, but this achievement reflects the dedication of our associates and the progress we are making to sharpen our strategic focus and improve execution. Third quarter results exceeded our expectations across revenue and adjusted EPS, and we generated robust free cash flow that allowed us to further strengthen our balance sheet.
articles.title: Avantor® Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

articles.summary: Avantor, Inc. (NYSE: AVTR), a leading global provider of mission-critical products and services to customers in the life sciences and advanced technology industries, welcomes Mikey Santiago as its new Chief Information Officer. In this role, Mikey will lead Avantor's global information technology strategy, advancing the company's digital transformation agenda while supporting growth, operational excellence, customer experience, and innovation across the enterprise. Emmanuel Ligner, President and CEO, Avantor, says: "Mikey brings an exceptional combination of business knowledge, technology leadership, and a proven ability to execute transformation at scale. With Mikey's experience in complex integrations, modernization efforts and AI-driven innovation, he will help position Avantor for the future." Mikey joins Avantor with more than two decades of technology leadership experience, including serving as a four-time CIO and holding senior leadership roles within the Danaher Corporation
